title: session/direct
description: Request `session/direct` (client -> daemon): steer an existing session. On an active session the instruction is queued and dispatched as the next turn of the same agent session when the current turn ends; on a terminated but resumable session it resumes with the instruction as the prompt, linked to the original; on a non-existent or non-resumable session it is a SESSION_NOT_FOUND error. Every instruction is recorded in the session log (queued, then sent). The third remote verb (monitor / approve / direct); consumable from all surfaces (core parity).

projectRoot.description: The project the session belongs to; locates its log and, on resume, the repository the agent runs in.

disposition.description: queued: the active session accepted the instruction as its next turn; resumed: a terminated resumable session was resumed with it.

sessionId.description: The session the instruction landed on: the same id when queued, or the new resumed session's id.

resumedFrom.description: When resumed, the original session this one continues.

queuePosition.description: 1-based position of the instruction in the queue, when queued.

status.description: The final turn status, when the instruction ran a turn (on resume).

deniedPermissions.description: Permission requests denied during the resumed turn (0 when merely queued); greater than zero means the result may be incomplete.
